description: Create PublishWorkflow UI components: a wizard-style panel with step indicator, ValidationResultsPanel, ApprovalStep with Master BOM preview, PublishConfirmation, and a 'Publish Template' button in the Toolbar. Integrate into App.tsx.
steps: Create src/components/PublishWorkflow/ directory with index.ts barrel export.

Create PublishWorkflow.tsx: A fixed overlay panel (similar to BomPanel.tsx pattern) that shows when publishStore.currentStep !== IDLE. Contains a step indicator showing the 4 steps (Validate, Generate BOM, Approve BOM, Publish) with current step highlighted. Renders the appropriate sub-component based on currentStep. Has a close/cancel button that calls publishStore.reset().

Create StepIndicator.tsx: Shows 4 steps with labels and visual states (completed/active/pending). Steps: 1-Validate, 2-Generate BOM, 3-Approve BOM, 4-Publish. Use data-testid='publish-step-indicator'.

Create ValidationResultsPanel.tsx: Renders publishStore.validationResults as a list of gate checks with pass/fail icons and messages. If all pass, shows a 'Generate Master BOM' button. If any fail, shows actionable error messages. Use data-testid='validation-results-panel'.

Create ApprovalStep.tsx: Shows the generated Master BOM in a read-only table (reuse BomSectionTable pattern from BomPanel/BomSectionTable.tsx for display). Shows BOM metadata (generated_at, engine_version). Has an 'Approve Master BOM' button that calls publishStore.approveMasterBom(). Use data-testid='approval-step'.

Create PublishConfirmation.tsx: Final step showing template name, confirmation message, and a 'Publish Template' button. Shows success state after publish completes. Use data-testid='publish-confirmation'.

Add 'Publish Template' button to Toolbar.tsx: visible only in DESIGNER mode when currentTemplate.status === 'DRAFT'. Clicking it calls publishStore.runValidation(currentTemplate.id) which starts the workflow. Use data-testid='publish-template-btn'.
Integrate PublishWorkflow into App.tsx: import and render PublishWorkflow component (conditionally based on publishStore step not being IDLE).
Handle error states: if publishTemplate fails due to DB trigger rejection, show the error message in PublishConfirmation with a retry button.
acceptance_criteria: PublishWorkflow panel renders as an overlay when workflow is active (currentStep !== IDLE)
StepIndicator shows 4 steps with correct active/completed/pending states
ValidationResultsPanel shows pass/fail results for each validation gate
ApprovalStep shows generated BOM lines and has Approve button
PublishConfirmation has Publish button and shows success/error states
Publish Template button appears in Toolbar only for DESIGNER mode with DRAFT template
DB trigger rejection errors are displayed to the user
verification: Run: cd /projects/sandbox/Bom/frontend && unset NODE_OPTIONS && npx tsc --noEmit
Run: cd /projects/sandbox/Bom/frontend && unset NODE_OPTIONS && npx vitest run
findings: All 145 tests pass. TypeScript compiles cleanly with --noEmit. Components follow BomPanel overlay pattern (fixed positioning, right-side panel, z-index 1001 to stack above BomPanel). Toolbar button conditionally renders for DESIGNER mode with DRAFT template. App.tsx conditionally renders the PublishWorkflow panel based on publishStore.currentStep !== IDLE.
